Intuitive Surgical 2026 procedure growth guidance da Vinci 5 market share competition

findings.claim: 2026 Q3 營收約 30.5 億美元、年增 22%；全球 da Vinci 手術量約 +14%（美國約 +10%、美國以外約 +20%）；Ion 手術量約 +31%；系統 546 台含 da Vinci 5 315 台
findings.excerpt: •Worldwide procedures (da Vinci and Ion combined) grew approximately 15% compared with the third quarter of 2025. Da Vinci procedures grew approximately 14%, and Ion procedures grew approximately 31%. •The Company placed 546 da Vinci surgical systems, compared with 427 in the third quarter of 2025. The third quarter 2026 da Vinci surgical system placements included 315 da Vinci 5 systems,

findings.claim: 2026 年 da Vinci 手術量成長指引 13.5%–15.5%；Q2 美國成長放緩至 12%，延後性手術偏弱；管理層提及中國競爭與定價壓力、GLP-1 壓抑減重手術
findings.source: Nasdaq: ISRG Q2 Earnings Call Signals Durable Demand & U.S. Caution
